camel_example: aliyun cloudapi DescribeApiGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key appname --Tag.1.Value test_app --GroupId 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d
description_en: Queries a specified API group, including its system-generated second-level domain name, custom domain names, and SSL Certificate information
description_zh: 查询API分组的详情信息，包含分组系统自动生成的二级域名、自定义域名及SSL证书信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi describe-api-group --group-id 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d --tag Value=test_app Key=appname --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApiGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and is globally unique
parameters.help_zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The object tags. You can specify multiple tags
parameters.help_zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个
parameters.name: tag

BasePath.description_en: The root path of the API

BillingStatus.description_en:
The billing status.

NORMAL: The billing is normal.

LOCKED: The group is locked due to an overdue payment
BillingStatus.description_zh:
计费状态

NORMAL：正常
LOCKED：欠费锁定

CompatibleFlags.description_en: A list of associated tags. Multiple tags are separated by commas (,)
CompatibleFlags.description_zh: 关联的标签列表，多个用逗号（,）分隔

CreatedTime.description_en: The creation time, which is in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建时间，格林威治时间

DomainItem.description_en: The information about the custom domain name

items.description_en: The information about the custom domain name

BindStageAlias.description_en: The alias of the environment to which the domain name is bound

BindStageName.description_en: The name of the environment to which the domain name is bound

CertificateId.description_en: The ID of the SSL certificate. This ID is automatically generated by the system and is unique
CertificateId.description_zh: SSL证书ID，系统自动生成唯一编号

CertificateName.description_en: The name of the SSL certificate

CertificateValidEnd.description_en: The time when the certificate expires

CertificateValidStart.description_en: The time when the certificate becomes valid

ClientCertSDnPassThrough.description_en: Indicates whether the \`ssl\_client\_s\_dn\` value in the certificate is passed to the backend service through the \`X-Client-S-Dn\` header
ClientCertSDnPassThrough.description_zh: 是否将证书中 ssl_client_s_dn 的值通过 Header 'X-Client-S-Dn' 传输给后端服务

CustomDomainType.description_en: The type of the custom domain name

DomainBindingStatus.description_en:
The binding status of the custom domain name. Valid values:

BINDING: The domain name is being bound.

BOUND: The domain name is bound
DomainBindingStatus.description_zh:
自定义域名绑定状态，取值：

BINDING：正常
BOUND：未生效

DomainCNAMEStatus.description_en:
The CNAME resolution status of the domain name. Valid values:

RESOLVED: The domain name is resolved.

UNRESOLVED: The domain name is not resolved
DomainCNAMEStatus.description_zh:
域名解析情况，取值：

RESOLVED：已解析
UNRESOLVED：未解析

DomainLegalStatus.description_en:
The validity status of the domain name. Valid values:

NORMAL: The domain name is valid.

ABNORMAL: The domain name is invalid. This status affects API calls. Resolve the issue as soon as possible
DomainLegalStatus.description_zh:
域名合法状态，取值：

NORMAL：正常
ABNORMAL：异常，该状态会影响API调用，需尽快解决

DomainRemark.description_en: The remarks about the domain name, such as the cause of an exception
DomainRemark.description_zh: 域名相关备注，如描述域名异常状态原因
DomainRemark.example: The domain name is not registered.

DomainWebSocketStatus.description_en: The status of the domain name that is used for WebSocket connections

IsHttpRedirectToHttps.description_en: Indicates whether HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS

SslOcspCacheEnable.description_en: Indicates whether OCSP caching is supported

SslOcspEnable.description_en: Indicates whether Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) validation is supported

CustomerConfigs.description_en: The list of custom configuration items

DedicatedInstanceType.description_en:
The type of the dedicated instance in which the group is located.

VPC-connected dedicated instance: \`vpc\_connect\`

Legacy dedicated instance: \`normal\`
DedicatedInstanceType.description_zh:
分组所在专享实例的类型
VPC融合类型专享实例：vpc_connect
传统类型专享实例：normal

Description.description_en: The description of the API group

DisableInnerDomain.description_en:
Indicates whether to disable access from the internet through the second-level domain name.

\`true\`: Access from the internet through the second-level domain name is disabled.

\`false\`: Access from the internet through the second-level domain name is allowed
DisableInnerDomain.description_zh:
是否禁止公网二级域名的访问
true：禁止公网二级域名访问
false：允许公网二级域名访问

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and is globally unique
GroupId.description_zh: API分组 ID，系统生成，全局唯一

GroupName.description_en: The name of the API group

IllegalStatus.description_en:
The lock status due to illegal activities.

NORMAL: The group is normal.

LOCKED: The group is locked due to illegal activities
IllegalStatus.description_zh:
违法锁定

NORMAL：正常
LOCKED：违法锁定

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type.

CLASSIC_SHARED: a shared instance in the classic network.

VPC_SHARED: a shared instance in a VPC.

VPC_DEDICATED: a dedicated instance in a VPC
InstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型
CLASSIC_SHARED：共享实例经典网络
VPC_SHARED：共享实例(VPC)
VPC_DEDICATED：专享实例(VPC)

MigrationError.description_en: The cause of the migration failure. This parameter is returned when the value of \`MigrationStatus\` is \`Fail\`
MigrationError.description_zh:
分组迁移实例任务失败时，失败的原因。
当MigrationStatus参数值为Fail时，不为空
MigrationError.example: The current instance conflicts with the target instance.

MigrationStatus.description_en:
The status of the task to migrate the group to another instance.

\`Running\`

\`Success\`

\`Fail\`
MigrationStatus.description_zh:
分组迁移实例任务状态
运行中：Running
成功：Success
失败：Fail

ModifiedTime.description_en: The last modification time, in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 最后修改时间，格林威治时间

RegionId.description_en: The region where the group is located

Status.description_en:
The status of the group.

NORMAL: The group is normal.

DELETE: The group is deleted
Status.description_zh:
分组状态

NORMAL：正常
DELETE：删除

SubDomain.description_en: The second-level domain name that is assigned to the group by the system
SubDomain.description_zh: 系统为分组分配的二级域名

TrafficLimit.description_en: The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) for the group. The default value is 500. To increase the limit, submit a request
TrafficLimit.description_zh: 分组最高QPS限制，默认500，可申请提高

VpcSlbIntranetDomain.description_en: The private domain name of the VPC SLB instance
